event_inputs.rho: Missing density or event shape is an event failure.
event_inputs.mu: Use float EventInfo.averageInteractionsPerCrossing. Missing EventInfo sets mu and NPV to zero; missing decoration on available EventInfo fails.
event_inputs.npv: Count PriVtx or PileUp in PrimaryVertices; use zero on missing PrimaryVertices.

source_contract.cases: Scalar area subtraction and simultaneous mu/NPV residual on MC.
source_contract.negative_pt: Only negative corrected pT resets to 10 MeV through four-vector scaling.
source_contract.invalid_inputs: Missing required jet auxiliary values and E<m are errors.
source_contract.eta_boundary: The release residual loop indexes past the last coefficient if no interval matches. The node reports that undefined input as an error.
source_contract.precision: Retain binary32 auxiliary reads and writes, binary64 density and arithmetic, and the source interval accumulation order.

small_pileup.acceptance: Compare [pt, eta, phi, m] to JetPileupScaleMomentum and exercise the negative reset, zero corrected pT, and residual eta edges.

event.truth: JetPileupLabelingTool::decorate and JetPileupLabelingTool.h defaults for both configured collections
event.selection: AsgSelectionAlg, AsgPtEtaSelectionTool, AsgMassSelectionTool with config/jets-a.yaml thresholds
event.event_sf: AsgEventScaleFactorAlg with valid per-jet SF or neutral weight in source order

event_inputs.moment_vertex_index: Use EventInfo.PVIndex when available, else the first PriVtx index or zero. Invalid nonzero index resets to zero when PrimaryVertices is present. A missing PrimaryVertices container returns before index validation.
event_inputs.missing_event_info: Original calibrator uses the default vertex index zero.

source_contract.gather: Require all three per-vertex inputs and four sampling slots before native evaluation. Preserve the checked index and report missing data or out-of-range array accesses.
source_contract.active_modes: Run charged fraction, Tile0, EM3, track count, and track width. The chosen depth and properties disable punch-through, track fade-out, and calo-only moments.
source_contract.response: A missing per-family eta bin or a nonphysical moment returns unity. Tile0 treats zero as a valid moment. Look up subsequent factors at updated pT and clamp each coordinate 1e-6 into its first/last histogram bins.
source_contract.precision: Use binary32 input moments and sampling-fraction arithmetic, binary64 response and cumulative scale, and binary32 p4 writes.

small_gsc.acceptance: Compare [pt, eta, phi, m] to JetGSCScaleMomentum with terminal eta-family cutoffs, zero/negative moments, and exact TH2 bin-boundary probes.

status_codes.-1: error: abort before writing the original decoration
status_codes.0: skipped: no new NNJvt decoration, or SF -1 without a new validity flag
status_codes.2: scale factor out of validity: write SF -1 and a false validity flag

status_notes.update: On a skip use inherited score availability/value for selection; ignore placeholder outputs.
status_notes.selection: Write the successful pass result through the framework as_char accessor.
status_notes.scale_factor: Histogram weight is the raw SF if valid, otherwise 1. A status of error aborts.
